variants.notes: Most penetrant HFE variant. C282Y homozygotes have ~10-25% lifetime iron overload risk; heterozygotes typically unaffected.
Mildly reduced function; compound heterozygous C282Y/H63D raises iron overload risk somewhat.

BRCA_ASHKENAZI.condition: Ashkenazi Jewish founder mutations — hereditary breast/ovarian/prostate/pancreatic cancer risk

variants.notes: BRCA1 frameshift; ~1% Ashkenazi allele frequency. Across carriers, population-average lifetime breast cancer risk is ~70% and ovarian ~40%; an individual's risk varies widely with family history and other factors.

BRCA2 frameshift; ~1.5% Ashkenazi allele frequency. Associated on average with elevated breast and prostate cancer risk across carriers; men carry meaningful prostate and male breast cancer risk. Individual risk varies with family history and other factors.
